title: Ask questions
subtitle: 「問問題／提問」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「問問題／提問」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 較正式地表示為取得資訊而提出一個或多個問題。
words.example: The manager made inquiries about the cause of the delay.
words.exampleZh: 經理查問了延誤的原因。

exercises.original: The manager asked questions about the cause of the delivery delay.
exercises.zh: 經理查問了送貨延誤的原因。
exercises.upgrade: made inquiries · 作出查詢

options.explanation: 表示為取得資訊而正式查問，和原句非常接近。
表示提供答案，方向和「提問」相反。
表示把某事說清楚，不是向別人詢問。
表示討論，可能包括問答，但不突出查詢資訊。
表示心裡想知道，不代表真的向任何人發問。
表示作出承諾，語義完全不同。

exercises.original: The customer asked several questions about the warranty before buying the product.
exercises.zh: 顧客在購買產品前查詢了幾項保養事宜。
exercises.upgrade: The customer made inquiries about the warranty before buying the product.

options.explanation: 正式詢問產品資料，非常自然。
是投訴，不一定是在尋求資料。

exercises.original: Officials asked questions to determine whether the licence was still valid.
exercises.zh: 官員作出查詢，以確定牌照是否仍然有效。
exercises.upgrade: Officials made inquiries to determine whether the licence was still valid.

options.explanation: 正式查詢資訊，符合行政語境。
是表達擔憂，不等於查詢。

words.note: 正式或較禮貌地詢問資訊。
words.example: She called to inquire about the course fees.

exercises.original: She called to ask questions about the course fees.
exercises.zh: 她致電查詢課程費用。
exercises.upgrade: She called to inquire about the course fees.

options.explanation: 表示投訴，不是一般查詢。
表示公布資訊，方向相反。
表示說明清楚，不是提出詢問。

exercises.original: He emailed the hotel to ask questions about late check-in.
exercises.zh: 他電郵酒店查詢延遲入住安排。
exercises.upgrade: He emailed the hotel to inquire about late check-in.

options.explanation: 酒店查詢語境非常自然。

exercises.original: Parents asked questions about whether extra lessons were available.
exercises.zh: 家長查詢是否有額外課堂。
exercises.upgrade: Parents inquired whether extra lessons were available.

options.explanation: inquire whether... 是正式自然結構。

words.note: 表示正式地提出一個或多個問題，常見於學術、討論、訪談和研究。
words.example: The report poses important questions about data privacy.
words.exampleZh: 這份報告提出了有關資料私隱的重要問題。

exercises.original: The report asks important questions about the future of artificial intelligence.
exercises.zh: 報告提出了有關人工智能未來的重要問題。
exercises.upgrade: The report poses important questions about the future of artificial intelligence.

options.explanation: 正式地表示「提出值得思考的問題」。

exercises.original: The speaker asked several difficult questions during the lecture.
exercises.zh: 講者在演講中提出了幾個困難問題。
exercises.upgrade: The speaker posed several difficult questions during the lecture.

options.explanation: pose a question 是正式、自然的搭配。

exercises.original: The research raises and asks questions about how children learn languages.
exercises.zh: 這項研究提出了兒童如何學習語言的問題。
exercises.upgrade: The research poses questions about how children learn languages.

options.explanation: 學術語境中「提出研究問題」非常自然。

words.note: 表示直接向某個人提出問題。
words.example: Journalists put several questions to the minister.
words.exampleZh: 記者向部長提出了幾個問題。

exercises.original: Journalists asked the minister several questions.
exercises.zh: 記者向部長提出了幾個問題。
exercises.upgrade: Journalists put several questions to the minister.

options.explanation: 正式地表示直接向某人提問。

exercises.original: Committee members asked questions of the witness.
exercises.zh: 委員會成員向目擊者提出問題。
exercises.upgrade: Committee members put questions to the witness.

options.explanation: 聽證／正式會議語境非常自然。

exercises.original: The interviewer asked the candidate a series of questions.
exercises.zh: 面試官向候選人提出了一連串問題。
exercises.upgrade: The interviewer put a series of questions to the candidate.
exercises.answer: put a series of questions to

options.text: put a series of questions to
options.explanation: 正式地表示一連串提問。

options.text: gave a series of answers to

options.explanation: 是提出要求，不等於問一連串問題。

words.note: 作動詞時可表示向某人提出問題，尤其是為了了解事實。
words.exampleZh: 警方詢問了數名目擊者。

exercises.original: Police asked several witnesses questions about the incident.
exercises.zh: 警方就事件詢問了數名目擊者。
exercises.upgrade: Police questioned several witnesses about the incident.

options.explanation: 調查語境中比普通 ask questions 更集中、正式。

exercises.original: The lawyer asked the witness questions for nearly an hour.
exercises.zh: 律師詢問目擊者接近一小時。
exercises.upgrade: The lawyer questioned the witness for nearly an hour.

exercises.original: Investigators asked staff questions about the missing files.
exercises.zh: 調查人員就遺失文件一事詢問員工。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators questioned staff about the missing files.

words.note: 較正式地提出問題，尤其要求確認、解釋或更正某事。
words.example: She queried the figure in the final report.
words.exampleZh: 她對最終報告中的那個數字提出疑問。

exercises.original: She asked a question about the figure in the report because it looked incorrect.
exercises.zh: 她對報告中的數字提出疑問，因為看起來不正確。
exercises.upgrade: She queried the figure in the report because it looked incorrect.

options.explanation: 帶有要求確認／質疑準確性的意味。

exercises.original: The auditor asked questions about several unusual expenses.
exercises.zh: 核數師對幾項異常開支提出疑問。
exercises.upgrade: The auditor queried several unusual expenses.

options.explanation: 核數語境中表示對項目提出查問／質疑。

exercises.original: The customer asked whether the additional charge was correct.
exercises.zh: 顧客對額外收費是否正確提出疑問。
exercises.upgrade: The customer queried the additional charge.

options.explanation: 表示要求確認某項收費。

words.meaning: 尋求澄清；要求進一步說明
words.note: 當問題的目的不是取得全新資訊，而是弄清楚已說過的內容時，非常自然。
words.example: Several students sought clarification on the assignment requirements.
words.exampleZh: 幾名學生要求進一步說明作業要求。

exercises.original: Several students asked questions because the assignment instructions were unclear.
exercises.zh: 幾名學生因作業指示不清而尋求澄清。
exercises.upgrade: Several students sought clarification on the assignment instructions.

options.explanation: 問題的目的就是把不清楚的要求弄明白。

exercises.original: The employee asked questions about what the new rule meant.
exercises.zh: 員工詢問新規則的意思，以尋求澄清。
exercises.upgrade: The employee sought clarification about the new rule.

exercises.original: Before signing, she asked questions about an ambiguous clause.
exercises.zh: 簽署前，她就一項含糊條款尋求澄清。
exercises.upgrade: Before signing, she sought clarification on an ambiguous clause.

words.meaning: 要求澄清；請對方說清楚
words.note: 和 seek clarification 非常接近，但更直接、較口語。
words.example: If the instructions are unclear, ask for clarification.
words.exampleZh: 如果指示不清楚，就要求進一步說明。

exercises.original: If you do not understand the instructions, ask questions so the teacher can explain them.
exercises.zh: 如果你不明白指示，就要求進一步說明。
exercises.upgrade: If you do not understand the instructions, ask for clarification.

options.explanation: 日常自然地要求別人說清楚。

exercises.original: She asked another question because she was not sure what the manager meant.
exercises.zh: 她因不確定經理的意思而要求澄清。
exercises.upgrade: She asked for clarification because she was not sure what the manager meant.

exercises.original: During the meeting, he asked questions whenever a point was unclear.
exercises.zh: 會議期間，每當有不清楚的地方，他都會要求澄清。
exercises.upgrade: During the meeting, he asked for clarification whenever a point was unclear.

words.note: 表示主動取得所需資訊，通常包括提問，但也可能透過閱讀、搜尋等方式。
words.example: Customers can contact the office to seek information about the programme.
words.exampleZh: 顧客可以聯絡辦公室查詢該計劃的資料。

exercises.original: Customers often ask questions about delivery times before placing an order.
exercises.zh: 顧客下單前常會查詢送貨時間。
exercises.upgrade: Customers often seek information about delivery times before placing an order.

options.explanation: 取得實用資料是核心目的。

exercises.original: Visitors can ask questions about local transport at the information desk.
exercises.zh: 訪客可在詢問處查詢當地交通資料。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors can seek information about local transport at the information desk.

exercises.original: Parents asked questions about the school's admission process.
exercises.zh: 家長查詢學校的入學程序。
exercises.upgrade: Parents sought information about the school's admission process.

words.meaning: 索取資訊；要求提供資料
words.note: 較正式，常見於書面查詢、商業、行政或客服語境。
words.example: Applicants may request information about the selection process.
words.exampleZh: 申請人可以索取有關甄選程序的資料。

exercises.original: Applicants may ask questions about the selection process by email.
exercises.zh: 申請人可以透過電郵索取甄選程序的資料。
exercises.upgrade: Applicants may request information about the selection process by email.

exercises.original: The customer wrote to ask questions about the cancellation policy.
exercises.zh: 顧客寫信索取取消政策的資料。
exercises.upgrade: The customer wrote to request information about the cancellation policy.

exercises.original: Researchers contacted the agency to ask questions about the dataset.
exercises.zh: 研究人員聯絡該機構索取數據集的相關資料。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers contacted the agency to request information about the dataset.

words.note: 表示透過一連串問題深入了解某件事。
words.example: The interviewer probed further into the candidate's experience.
words.exampleZh: 面試官進一步追問候選人的經驗。

exercises.original: The interviewer asked more questions about the gap in the candidate's employment history.
exercises.zh: 面試官進一步追問候選人履歷中的空白期。
exercises.upgrade: The interviewer probed further into the gap in the candidate's employment history.

options.explanation: 表示有目的地深入追問。

exercises.original: Journalists kept asking questions about the unexplained payment.
exercises.zh: 記者持續深入追問那筆無法解釋的款項。
exercises.upgrade: Journalists probed the unexplained payment further.

exercises.original: The researcher asked detailed follow-up questions about participants' experiences.
exercises.zh: 研究人員就參與者的經驗作詳細追問。
exercises.upgrade: The researcher probed participants' experiences with detailed follow-up questions.

options.explanation: follow-up questions 是典型 probe 語境。

words.note: 常見固定表達，表示向多個人詢問，以取得資訊或建議。
words.example: I'll ask around and see if anyone knows a good electrician.
words.exampleZh: 我會四處打聽，看看有沒有人認識好的電工。

exercises.original: I'll ask several people if they know a good plumber.
exercises.zh: 我會四處打聽，看有沒有人認識好的水喉匠。
exercises.upgrade: I'll ask around and see if anyone knows a good plumber.

options.explanation: 固定口語表達，表示向多個人打聽。

exercises.original: She asked different colleagues whether anyone had seen the missing document.
exercises.zh: 她四處問同事，看有沒有人見過遺失的文件。
exercises.upgrade: She asked around to see whether anyone had seen the missing document.

options.explanation: 多個人＋打聽資訊，完全符合。

exercises.original: We asked questions among local residents to find someone who remembered the event.
exercises.zh: 我們向當地居民四處打聽，尋找記得事件的人。
exercises.upgrade: We asked around among local residents to find someone who remembered the event.

words.note: 表示提出問題或進行調查，希望找出真相或答案。
words.example: Researchers are seeking answers to several unresolved questions.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員正在尋找幾個未解問題的答案。

exercises.original: Researchers continue to ask questions about why the disease affects some people more severely.
exercises.zh: 研究人員繼續尋找答案，了解為甚麼這種疾病對部分人的影響更嚴重。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers continue to seek answers about why the disease affects some people more severely.

options.explanation: 強調提問和研究的目標是找到答案。

exercises.original: The family kept asking questions after the unexplained disappearance.
exercises.zh: 那宗無法解釋的失蹤事件後，家人一直尋找答案。
exercises.upgrade: The family sought answers after the unexplained disappearance.

options.explanation: 自然表示希望找出真相。

exercises.original: Investigators are asking questions to determine exactly what happened.
exercises.zh: 調查人員正在尋找答案，以確定事情的真相。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators are seeking answers to determine exactly what happened.

words.note: 表示用一連串問題測試某人的知識，或仔細詢問某人。
words.example: The teacher quizzed the students on the vocabulary.
words.exampleZh: 老師就詞彙內容提問學生。

exercises.original: The teacher asked the students questions about yesterday's vocabulary.
exercises.zh: 老師就昨天的詞彙考問學生。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher quizzed the students on yesterday's vocabulary.

options.explanation: 表示透過問題測試知識。

exercises.original: My friend kept asking me questions to see how much I knew about the film.
exercises.zh: 朋友一直問我問題，測試我對這部電影知道多少。
exercises.upgrade: My friend quizzed me to see how much I knew about the film.

exercises.original: The interviewer asked the actor many detailed questions about the new film.
exercises.zh: 訪問者就新電影向演員密集提問。
exercises.upgrade: The interviewer quizzed the actor about the new film.

options.explanation: 除了「考問」，quiz someone about 也可表示密集詢問。

falseSynonyms.zh: 心裡想知道，不等於真正開口問 wonder 可以表示心中有疑問，但你可能完全沒有向任何人提問。 我心裡想知道她為甚麼離開。 我真的向她問了這個問題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I wondered why she left. I asked her why she left.

falseSynonyms.zh: 討論不等於提問 discuss 表示交換想法；過程中可能會問問題，但核心不是「提問」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We discussed the problem. We asked several questions about the problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 澄清不等於要求澄清 clarify 是把事情說清楚的人所做的動作。 seek clarification 是不明白的人要求進一步解釋。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teacher clarified the rule. The student asked for clarification.

falseSynonyms.zh: 挑戰／質疑不等於一般提問 有些 question 可以帶質疑意味，但 challenge 更強，通常表示反對或要求對方證明。
訪談是一整個活動，不等於單純問問題 Interview 通常包含一系列 questions，但它本身是一個完整的互動形式。
審問不等於一般詢問 interrogate 語氣非常強，表示正式、密集甚至帶壓力地盤問。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The journalist questioned the witness. The suspect was interrogated by police.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提出要求不等於提出問題 request 是要求某人做某事或提供某物。 只有 request information 才在某些語境接近 ask questions。
回答問題和提出問題方向相反 ask questions = 提問。 answer questions = 回答。
